description: This file contains the PHP class definition for the Reward controller in the OpenCart system, handling the reward points page in the user account area. It manages fetching reward data, pagination, and generating the view for the rewards page.

classes.name: Reward
classes.description: The Reward controller class handles the display of reward points for the logged-in customer, including pagination and breadcrumb navigation.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that handles displaying the reward points page, including loading language, checking authentication, preparing data, handling pagination, and rendering the view.
